text: i posted about a month ago with the title "ready to die." the subject was essentially accepting the reality of suicide and its inevitability for many. i don't know what my future holds or if things can turn around. i am a case though of someone who is perhaps a little too clever to get better. i see the lines and recognize the one i am on. and i understand the secret sacrifice that one makes in order to live. i am aware that life is painful. and i have made a deep commitment internally to be done with pain. i have no desire to do anything that is in any way painful, even if it is done in the service of good, especially if it is done in the service of good. granted, i still do in some ways as is necessary to continue living and to have some degree of well-being, but slowly but surely, i find myself drifting ever more towards the reality where i am no longer doing anything, paralyzed by the pain of existence, slowly dying. in this way, i am not long for this life. i recognize the irony - that by refusing to accept pain, one undergoes the severest of pains, the pain of a lonely, undignified death. however, there is something there, a sense of integrity for me by rejecting the pain of this life. like the slave who refuses to bow before his master. it is futile i know. it's not so much that i am refusing to bow as it is that i am refusing to get up. i'm like the man who's been whipped, falls to the ground, and dies under the fury of a thousand lashes that are meant to raise him to his feet, but only serve to push him deeper into the pavement. i am the weak link darwin's less fit. amp;
